name: upstream-nested-o
source:
------------------------------ MODULE O ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

\* Begin nested (inner) module
   ---- MODULE Inner ----
   EXTENDS Naturals

   VARIABLES y

   Step == /\ y < 3
           /\ y' = y + 1

   Bound == y <= 3
   =====
\* End nested (inner) module

VARIABLES x

(* One instantiation reached from both the next-state relation and the       *)
(* invariant. The expression substituted for y is counted separately for     *)
(* each of them, even though they share the Subst of the semantic graph.     *)
I == INSTANCE Inner WITH y <- x

Init == x = 0

Next == I!Step

Inv == I!Bound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x

============
config:
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Inv
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

----------------------------- MODULE Instances -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

VARIABLES left, right, shared

Values == 0..2

Left == INSTANCE Channel WITH Data <- Values, channel <- left

Right == INSTANCE Channel WITH Data <- Values, channel <- right

Pair(target) == INSTANCE Channel WITH Data <- Values, channel <- target

INSTANCE Channel WITH Data <- Values, channel <- shared

Init == left = 0 /\ right = 0 /\ shared = 0

Next == \/ /\ \E item \in Values : Left!Send(item)
           /\ Right!Idle
           /\ Idle
        \/ /\ \E item \in Values : Right!Send(item)
           /\ UNCHANGED <<left, shared>>
        \/ /\ \E item \in Values : Send(item)
           /\ UNCHANGED <<left, right>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<left, right, shared>>

Safe == Left!TypeOK /\ Pair(right)!TypeOK /\ TypeOK

Different == left + right + shared < 6
=============================================================================

INVARIANT Safe
